meta.description: A French-speaking Seventh-day Adventist church in the heart of Indianapolis. Sabbath worship, Sabbath School, youth, praise and a warm community waiting for you.

hero.text: A church where people know your name. Come as you are, this Sabbath.

venir.title: Your first Sabbath, made simple.
venir.text: Come as you are. Someone will greet you at the door, help you find a seat and answer your questions.

ministeres.title: There is a place for everyone.
ministeres.serve: Want to serve? Talk to us

messages.title: Far from Indianapolis? Worship comes to you.
messages.text: Every Sabbath the service is streamed live on YouTube. Previous sermons are there too, to listen again or share.

agenda.title: Coming up
agenda.empty: Upcoming events will be announced here. Until then, join us this Sabbath!

don.title: Support the mission,
don.text: Gifts go through AdventistGiving, the Adventist Church’s secure platform. Automatic tax receipt.
